title: Add transcript path and resume metadata parity
objective: Preserve full-history recoverability and resume display semantics around compaction by adding transcript references and metadata re-append behavior.
implementation_scope: Identify or add a session transcript path provider for compact summaries.
Pass transcriptPath into GetCompactUserSummaryMessage when available.
Write a reduced transcript segment for pre-compaction messages if Go has transcript segment storage.
Re-append session metadata such as custom title/tag after compaction if Go stores lite metadata near the transcript tail.
Ensure compact boundary and content replacement records remain resume-safe.
out_of_scope: Do not redesign all session storage.
Do not add transcript support for providers or modes that do not persist sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Compact summary includes a readable transcript path when one exists.
Resume metadata remains visible after compaction in a regression test.
Missing transcript support degrades cleanly without empty or misleading instructions.
risks: Transcript paths can expose local paths to the model; match existing product expectations.
Metadata re-append must not create duplicate user-visible messages.
dispatch_prompt: Add transcript path, reduced transcript segment, and resume metadata preservation around Go compaction to match TS behavior where supported.
